note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are this ledger's own words; each cites its sources by name, with a link where the source is a page. Counts (stunts, ranges, strands, spots) are PSN's tracked targets as reported by the cited guides.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, the missable sweep, collectibles, activities, and finally money and the 100% checklist. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours in a single playthrough, all offline.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.when: Last — earned automatically once the other 54 are done.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing — Jason's first mission — and it pops at the end of the mission. Just play the story; nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.when: Story — opening mission, Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 1 to its end. While you are in Chapter 1, do the one missable thing in the whole game first: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and meditate with her on the balcony — PowerPyx flags that first meditation as the only missable step toward Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.when: Story — end of Chapter 1. Do the balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 2 and it pops. Keep scanning new vehicles with the WAiNK app and studying animals through binoculars as you go — that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist even though the checklist itself only appears after the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.when: Story — end of Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3. By now the side strands are opening up — take stranger missions when their icons appear, since the Strangers & Freaks silver needs eight finished strands and their final missions feed the missable set.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.when: Story — end of Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4. There is no mission replay in GTA 6, so keep a separate save at the start and end of each chapter — PowerPyx suggests ten slots rotated this way — in case you ever want a clean shot at a chapter-locked moment.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.when: Story — end of Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish the final mission and the credits roll with this gold. After the story you keep free-roam of Leonida and the 100% Completion checklist unlocks under Progress, then Stats — everything left for the platinum is still reachable.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.when: Story — the final mission.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story. No preparation needed — mission trophies pop on completion.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.when: Story — mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist practice here pays off later: the open-world bank vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal use the same get-in, get-out rhythm.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.when: Story — mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play when the story brings it. Nothing to set up in advance.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.when: Story — mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Headliners. It pops at mission end, like every other story-mission trophy.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.when: Story — mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. The airport is also the stage for Catch Me If You Can, so learn the runways and exits here — you will come back for an unscheduled departure.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.when: Story — mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. With it done, the story-mission set is nearly complete — only the final mission remains for the gold.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.when: Story — mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the last big one before the platinum. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist. It is lenient — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly, but every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest is required, plus 70 of the 80 Challenges. Budget around 100 hours for this phase alone.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.when: After the story — work the Progress > Stats > 100% Completion checklist.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps all count. Stunts you pull off naturally while travelling add up, but the efficient route is to sweep stunt spots deliberately in free-roam after the story, using the fastest bike or plane you own and retrying from a nearby save.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.when: Anytime — best swept in free-roam after the story. Target: 250 of 397.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You do not need to win or finish anything — one try at each is enough, so knock this out early by sampling one of each as you pass them.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.when: Anytime — sample one of each of the 9 activity types.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx notes the gold medals are not too difficult — learn each range's target pattern, take the steadiest weapon you have, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold clears. Every range is also required for the 100% checklist, so this is not optional.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.when: Anytime — all 42 challenges, gold each. Also required for 100%.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Fly the racing line, not the scenery: cut corners where the gates allow and keep the drone low to hold speed. Every location is also required for the 100% checklist, so a win at each does double duty.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.when: Anytime — one win at each of the 14 drone race locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Work through the race types across Leonida with a well-upgraded car, and favour the shorter circuits first so each win banks quickly. Race wins also feed the Challenges count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.when: Anytime — 20 different race events won.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activities for Master of None, so you will already know the casting and reeling rhythm; for Cal, use the best rod and bait you can buy and keep the line tension in the safe zone rather than rushing the catch.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.when: Anytime — challenge Cal to a fishing contest and win.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any machine, any game, start to finish. Arcades are scattered around Vice City; pick the shortest game on the cabinet and play it through. One completion is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.when: Anytime — finish any single arcade game.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Finish Andy's stranger mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. Stranger strands can close off as the story moves on, so do Andy's missions as soon as his icon appears instead of leaving the strand for post-story cleanup — there is no mission replay to go back with.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Andy's strand before the story moves past it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. Like the other named strangers, his strand is time-sensitive inside the story, so prioritise his missions whenever his icon shows.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Kenton's strand before the story moves past it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Finish Billy's stranger mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. Keep an eye on the map for his icon between story missions and clear his strand promptly.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Billy's strand before the story moves past it.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Complete eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida — the five named contacts (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus Bret and the other strangers you meet. The strands are the spine of Phase 2: start each one when its icon appears and finish it before moving far into the story, since strands can close off.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.when: MISSABLE — 8 full strands; do them as they appear. Target: 8.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Finish Randy's stranger mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. Do not let his strand sit unfinished while you push the story forward.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Randy's strand before the story moves past it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand through to his final mission and complete it. With all five named contacts done, the Strangers & Freaks silver is within reach — only Bret and the remaining strands are left.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.when: MISSABLE — finish Tyrone's strand before the story moves past it.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. WARNING — the one genuinely missable step in the game, per PowerPyx: the first meditation is in Chapter 1 at Jason's house, after the mission Down to Earth, when Lucia mentions meditating in the morning — follow her to the balcony and accept. Miss that and the whole trophy is at risk, because there is no mission replay. The other 17 spots can be found in free-roam; check the cited guide for the full spot list.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.when: CHAPTER 1 WARNING — do the balcony meditation with Lucia before leaving Chapter 1. Target: 18 spots.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for and bring it back to him. Bret's quests are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so his strand is doubly important: start it when it appears and finish every hunt he gives you, including this unique-animal one.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.when: MISSABLE — hunt Bret's unique animal when his strand offers it.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets — there are 18 sets in the game, and 15 of them count toward the 100% checklist, so this silver is a milestone on the way to a bigger requirement. Cards are found across Leonida; sweep a region at a time and use the WAiNK app to log what you find.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.when: Anytime — 3 full sets of the 18. Target: 3 sets.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Open the app whenever you see the prompt at a new place; scanning is also how Whip It Good's 100 vehicles get discovered, so make WAiNK a habit from the first hour and this silver arrives on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.when: Anytime — scan 100 spots with WAiNK. Target: 100.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. You only need 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, so pick the easiest 50 first — races, stunts and activities you already do all feed the count — and skip the hardest ones entirely. Check Progress to see which challenge groups are closest to done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.when: Anytime — 50 of the 80 Challenges. Target: 50.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it during the story while partner missions are flowing — after the story, partner opportunities are harder to arrange. Break line of sight, switch vehicles, and use alleys and the subway to shake the tail before the stars drop.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.when: MISSABLE — do it with your partner during the story; 4 stars, then escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — keep the heat on through all three. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep a getaway car ready; losing the cops even once between robberies breaks the chain.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.when: MISSABLE — 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, wanted level kept throughout.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — a WAiNK scan of a new vehicle counts as a discovery, so this pairs with You WAiNKer!. Drive everywhere, scan everything unfamiliar, and remember the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep going past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.when: Anytime — discover 100 vehicles (WAiNK scan counts). Target: 100.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up: lure a group together, top up your focus first with food, a drink or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle so each burst drops its target before the focus bar runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.when: Anytime — 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus. Target: 5.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. In plain terms: get a plane off the ground at Vice City International without a flight plan, dodging the airport's attention. Learn the runway layout during the VCIA Takedown mission, then come back in free-roam, grab a plane and go.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.when: Anytime — an unscheduled takeoff from VCIA airport.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Take a Rhino tank for a spin — the description's wink is the requirement: get into a Rhino and drive it. Tanks appear around military spots; this is one of the six open-world hidden trophies, so do it while you are sweeping the map rather than leaving it to the very end, when access can be awkward.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.when: MISSABLE — get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean stealth job. Case the store first, go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a detected run does not count.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.when: Anytime — one jewelry store, zero detections.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big robberies in the 100% checklist too, so every one counts twice. Plan the escape before the entry: a fast car parked close, a route away from the main roads, and no lingering to loot after the alarm.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.when: Anytime — 5 vaults robbed and escaped. Target: 5.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Watch for trucks on their routes around Leonida, block one in, crack it open and get clear before the response arrives. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.when: Anytime — one armored truck robbed, then escape.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region of the map. Drive the highways, visit the towns, the keys, the swamps and the city until the map is filled in. Exploring as you do the story and the WAiNK scans covers most of it; finish the last blank corners in free-roam.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.when: Anytime — cover every region of the Leonida map.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — every gang's operation, not just one. Gang operations are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so clear them methodically, gang by gang, and tick each one off as you go.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.when: MISSABLE — one illegal operation per gang, all gangs.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy is about the moment, not a challenge, so just sit, order and let it pop.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.when: Anytime — cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. This is one of the hidden open-world trophies whose exact trigger is still being pinned down by the guides, so check the cited source for the confirmed showroom and approach, and do it while showrooms are accessible in your playthrough.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.when: MISSABLE — smash out of a vehicle showroom; check the cited guide for the confirmed spot.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a proper game there. The alley is also the stage for Ten Pin, so learn the lanes here: a full game at this alley is the requirement, and the cited guides list the alley's location.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.when: Anytime — bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley.

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — max out strength with both Jason and Lucia, per the guides' reading of this trophy. Train with both characters regularly: gym sessions, sports and the activities that build strength, until both are at their peak.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.when: Anytime — max strength with both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE. Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the guides' reading of this hidden trophy. Every crime, robbery and wanted-level escape feeds the profile, so this builds up across a normal playthrough; if it has not popped by the end, keep working criminal actions in free-roam. Because it is tied to story choices, do the criminal work as you go rather than assuming it can all be done at the end.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.when: MISSABLE — 500 Criminal Profile actions; build them up during the story. Target: 500.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE. A hidden trophy whose exact unlock is still being confirmed by the guides — the name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something that failed the first time. Check the cited guide for the confirmed method before you chase it, and do not burn a one-shot opportunity on a first attempt you cannot repeat.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.when: MISSABLE — method still being confirmed; check the cited guide first.

trophies.guide: MISSABLE. A hidden trophy whose unlock is still being confirmed by the guides — the description reads like a rare random event. Check the cited guide for the confirmed trigger before chasing it; rare-event trophies are best attempted while you are already sweeping the map, not as a standalone grind.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.when: MISSABLE — rare-event trigger still being confirmed; check the cited guide.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by — strike someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, bowling-style. Line up a slow pass, swing as you drive by, and keep the vehicle moving; the cited guides are still pinning down the exact spot, with the Kolt & Associates alley area the natural place to try it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.when: Anytime — a melee drive-by takedown.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; move them through contacts in batches as you earn them rather than hoarding, and the total climbs across the playthrough. Robberies for the crime trophies are the main supply.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.when: Anytime — launder $250,000 of Marked Bills. Target: $250,000.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food, everything counts. You will pass this naturally buying gear for the harder trophies; if you are short at the end, buy the most expensive ammo and upgrades rather than saving for a single big purchase.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.when: Anytime — $100,000 total spent in shops. Target: $100,000.

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties across Leonida. Garages cost serious money, so buy them as your laundering and robbery income allows — they also give you somewhere to keep the 10 vehicles you register for On the Spot. Keep a checklist of which garages you own.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.when: Anytime — buy all 8 garage properties. Target: 8.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you want to keep, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — your garages from Little Boxes give you the space to store them. Any ten vehicles count, so start with the ones you already drive.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.when: Anytime — register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Target: 10.
